label: Age
note: Vendor-derived band. The self-reported age item exists in FU26 only.

label: Income
note: Vendor-derived, and only two bands - a coarser measure than the others, which can only lower its score.

label: Partisanship or political ideology
note: The expert item names partisanship or ideology; Party_ID is used because it is vendor-derived and present in both waves. ideol gives a similar answer.

label: Prior awareness or familiarity with fusion energy
note: Had you heard of fusion energy before reading the description. Three groups: yes, no, not sure.

label: Trust in scientists or scientific institutions
note: Trust in information about fusion energy from university scientists who study it. Measures trust in scientists AS A SOURCE ON FUSION, so it is partly downstream of fusion attitudes rather than independent of them. nas_trust gives a close answer. labs_trust is excluded: it is split-sampled between two different organisations.

label: Views toward traditional nuclear (fission) energy
note: FU26 only, so this one rests on 1,244 respondents rather than 2,444. Worded to match new_fusion word for word, which is what makes it a clean comparison.

label: Concern about climate change or environmental issues
note: Concern about the environment including pollution and climate change. gccrsk (perceived risk of global warming) and gcc (belief) are close alternatives.
